call_points.text: Realised USD/INR rate rose to INR90.6 in Q4 from INR86.5 a year ago, a margin tailwind; company is unhedged.
Exports targeted at 220,000+ units per month this quarter, up from 200,000 levels, despite Gulf business loss.
Chetak capacity now 50,000 units a month; management says a substantive capacity increase is needed and is under study.
KTM/BMAG consolidated line-by-line from November; FY27 will report with a one-quarter lag.
Supply chain issues (LPG shortage, manpower, logistics) impaired ability to service demand by 10-15% in April.
Management declined to give a full-year growth view, citing volatility; guidance is month by month.

guidance.statement: Domestic motorcycle industry growth expected at 7-9% in the near term
Exports run-rate to move to 220,000+ units per month this quarter
Q1FY27 commodity inflation estimated at 3.5-4% of revenue, 40% offset by pricing
Capacity expansion from 7 million units per annum to progressively 9 million units per annum
Chetak capacity to be unlocked from 50,000 to 60,000 units in the immediate term
Exports to move beyond 250,000 units per month this quarter and onwards
About 10 new variants plus 2 new Pulsar models to launch within 6 weeks; two new 125cc brands within the fiscal

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Automobiles > 2/3 Wheelers

operating_notes.text: April 2026 total sales stood at 5,13,792 units (+40% YoY).
Chetak crossed 5 lakh units and ₹4,000 Cr revenue in FY26; capacity now 50,000 units a month.
Exports FY26 revenue was USD 2.2 billion, the highest ever, with Nigeria at 50% of peak and 50% retail market share.
Electric 2W+3W business is over 20% of domestic revenues and contributed double-digit EBITDA margin in FY26.
Bajaj Mobility AG Q1 2026 motorcycle sales reached 40,332 units (+125.1% YoY).
BAIH BV fully repaid EUR 80 million to JP Morgan and DBS, terminating the loan agreements.
May 2026: 2W domestic 2,09,528 (+9% YoY), 2W exports 1,83,676 (+30%), CV domestic 38,503 (+12%), CV exports 29,550 (+65%).
Exports business unit set a record 7,32,000 units and USD 735 million revenue in Q1FY27, about 40% of Bajaj Auto revenue.
Three-wheeler exports hit a record 100,000 units, up almost 70%, with over 65% share of India's three-wheeler exports.
Spares revenue held at ₹1,700-1,800 Cr in Q1FY27 with record margins; BACL total income crossed ₹1,100 Cr with PAT of ₹227 Cr.

predictions.kpi: EBITDA margin held near 20.9% as broader cost inflation hits for the full quarter

timeline.summary: Niraj Bajaj (Promoter Group) declared no encumbrance on Bajaj Auto shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI Regn 31(4) on 3rd April 2026.
Bajaj Auto reported April 2026 total sales of 5,13,792 units
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹17,832.46 Cr (+41.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹3,661.92 Cr (+103.2% YoY).
Bajaj Auto board approved a ₹5,633 Cr share buyback at ₹12,000 per share via tender offer.
Bajaj Auto Limited’s Board, led by Rajiv Natvarlal Natvarlal Gandhi, recommended a final dividend of ₹150 per equity share for FY2026, payable by 24 July 2026.
Bajaj Auto Limited held its Q4 & FY26 results conference call on 06 May 2026 at 07:15 p.m. IST, with audio recording available on the company’s website.
Bajaj Auto's Q4/FY26 call (6 May 2026) guided near-term domestic motorcycle growth down to 7-9% and flagged Q1FY27 commodity inflation of 3.5-4% of revenue, only ~40% covered by April price hikes.
Bajaj Mobility AG reported Q1 2026 consolidated revenue of EUR 331.3 mn and positive EBITDA of EUR 5.5 mn.
Bajaj Auto announced that its subsidiary BAIH BV terminated loan agreements with JP Morgan and DBS after fully repaying EUR 80 million.
Bajaj Auto reported May 2026 total sales of 4,61,257 units

On its 21 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Bajaj Auto reported record standalone revenue of ₹17,244 Cr (+37% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹3,596 Cr at a 20.9% margin, with consolidated revenue of ₹21,689 Cr, and flagged a 7-to-9 million unit capacity expansion.
